summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2004-10 filed an 8-K reporting the furnishing of a preliminary remarketing memorandum by administrator Navient Solutions for the remarketing of Class A-7A, A-7B, and A-8 reset rate notes. No price, premium, or other deal terms were disclosed. This is a routine remarketing event for an asset-backed security trust, part of normal servicing of outstanding notes, not a special situation. The filing provides updated pool statistics as of May 31, 2026. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or corporate restructuring; it is a standard administrative update under Item 8.01.
